fusions.name: Furrow Burst
fusions.desc: Throws a stone crescent that deals 30 rock damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Gravel Fling
fusions.desc: Flings flint chips for 5 rock damage, rising to 1.5 times that at their full reach of 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Put to the Whetstone
fusions.desc: Increases your slashing damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Chips Off the Edge
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
